author: superlinked
description:
SIE task evidence
	

The recorded inputs and model responses behind the task pages on
superlinked.com, one folder per task.
Every figure published on a task page was produced by a real recorded run against
https://api.superlinked.com, or, for some tasks (typed-decisions among them),
against a self-hosted SIE server at a pinned commit on the GPU that task's
manifest.json records. This dataset holds those recordings so that anyone
can re-derive the published numbers without an API… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/superlinked/sie-task-evidence.
